sections.heading: 1. The neighborhood, tied to the stack
paragraphs: Seven lanes dug the same neighborhood from seven angles and every headline deflated while the machinery survived. The paper's 100x is an extrapolation past the last measured point: the deep lane read Table 4 and found 26.5x at 1M tokens as the largest MEASURED comparison, on 32 H100s with sequence parallelism, and 2.4-3.7x at 128k on one to four GPUs, which is the estate-relevant scale. The 97 percent energy figure is per-MAC arithmetic (0.034 pJ per spike event) contingent on neuromorphic hardware that, per the hardware lane's proved negative, serves at most 370M parameters today. And the weights were never on HuggingFace: the deep lane's HF API probe returned an empty BICLab author list; the README hosts them on ModelScope. The record self-corrected inside one dig, which is the estate working as designed.

What survived deflation is exactly what a sovereignty estate needs. SpikingBrain-7B is a Qwen2.5-7B upcycled to hybrid-linear attention on about 2 percent of the data (150B tokens), trained on hundreds of MetaX GPUs, non-NVIDIA, with quantized W8ASpike weights at a measured 1-3 percent quality cost and a runnable path (vllm-hymeta plugin, vllm 0.10.0 pin, plus an in-repo HF transformers version). The quality bill is real and must stay on the card: MMLU drops 8.37 points against the source model, IFEval drops 30.5. The linear-family lane widened this from one model to a class: ten architectures verified, five open and locally-runnable at 7B-14B (Granite 4.0 H-Tiny/H-Micro, Nemotron-Nano-9B-v2, Qwen3.5-4B, RWKV-7 G1 7.2B, Falcon-H1 7B), with the KV constraint class dissolved in the memory dimension while the recall wall stands, and the upcycle lane's law that only hybrids clear the SWA+4-sinks recall bar.

The estate's own organs already carry the shape. The event-driven-resonance lane found four byte-backed convergences between spiking neuroscience and estate code, sharpest at C1: only-thinks-when-triggered is the boot-trigger law, the dirty-block law, and the board_quiescent organ gate, arrived at independently. The Strata drop's hot-lattice hologram mapping (operator recognition, on the record in STRATA_DROP_20261001.md) names the tiering - GPU standing wave, RAM lattice, SSD hologram plate - and the adoption posture: our record through their engine, model disposable, record permanent. The brain-inspired turn did not teach the estate a new shape; it proved at paper grade that the shape scales off the Western accelerator stack.

sections.heading: 2. Efficiency as sovereignty, with the bound layer named
paragraphs: The operator's frame holds with one correction the lanes forced: the model that needs less is the model that survives, but at estate scale the channel it survives is licensing, not silicon. The nonnvidia-stacks lane ruled the export-control bound non-binding here - it binds China access and frontier volume, while ECCN 3A090.a country licensing stays aimed at China (the RTX 4090 restriction) with consumer carve-outs live - and the live threat to a US one-box estate is model-weight licensing (the Is-Informed precedent), which reaches distribution, not local fine-tune for own use.

A needs-less model hedges every layer at once: it runs on hardware already owned (the RDNA1 box runs a 7B Q4 by Vulkan inference; the energy lane measured gemma:2b at 84.65 tok/s on the 3800XT), it survives the memory supercycle inflating VRAM, and if a licensing letter ever reaches open weights, the estate's insulation is that its stack is small, quantized, and locally healable. The brain-inspired turn's demonstration is that the architecture layer is where a compute bound loosens: SpikingBrain trained at paper grade on domestic clusters, at 2 percent of the data. The estate's version of that move is not buying foreign silicon - the hardware lane closed neuromorphic spend to NO for 2026 with three named revisit triggers - it is the ladder discipline itself (small models, Q4 bytes, power caps, convert-don't-train) plus the verified non-NVIDIA rungs: R0 own-box inference at $0, TPU v5e chip-hours at $0.60-1.20 for episodic fine-tunes, and the RX 7900 XTX as the only vendor-supported owned non-NVIDIA training card.

And the energy law at our scale is quantization-first: the energy lane's verdict line is that quantization plus serving knobs move measured energy 1.3-5x TODAY, architecture change pays only through the long-context door, and small model size is the whole game (1B to 70B is only 7.3x joules per token). Spiking's headline lives at the operation level on 45nm assumptions; the janitor rung's joules live in the bytes moved.

sections.heading: 3. Three concrete moves, ranked by cost
paragraphs: MOVE 1, $0, one sitting: the R0 Vulkan gate probe. Load one 7B Q4 GGUF through llama.cpp's Vulkan backend on the RX 5600 XT box and time tok/s at 8k context. This single measurement decides whether SpikingBrain-7B and the whole linear-family candidate set join the local ladder or stay cloud-only, and it is the gate for pulling ModelScope weights later. Landing spot: a probe receipt beside watch/inbox/spiking_wide/.

MOVE 2, $0 to single-digit dollars, one sitting plus one priced option: GO 1, the convert-don't-train layer probe - depth-prune 20-35 percent of a 7B's layers on the same 4GB box, score it, land it in upcycle-economics.md - and the pricing line-item: the first real fine-tune need is quoted as a TPU v5e Flex-start job (single-digit dollars per run) before any GPU card is bought. Together these convert architecture experimentation from a research project into a priced, repeatable option.

MOVE 3, about $300, when the DDR3 body lands: one body, three falsifiable probes. The 12GB GPU runs GO 2 (depth-prune plus QLoRA heal, the estate's first owned training tier), serves the Strata vs llama.cpp --n-cpu-moe duel (the hot lattice hologram's first hardware incarnation), and runs the linear-family eval cards scored against the SWA+4-sinks R0 incumbent, because only hybrids clear the recall bar. Closed doors, for the record: no neuromorphic silicon in 2026, no cluster-class upcycle attempts (579 consumer-GPU-days says no), no pure linearizations (dead on arrival against the sinks baseline), and no energy bet on spiking until joules per token are measured on identical hardware.

chapter.operator_question_answer: Does the brain-inspired turn change the local ladder or decorate it? It changes the spec of one rung and decorates everything else. The ladder's shape survives because every multiplier that survives primary reading shrinks at estate scale: the 100x is 26.5x at 1M tokens on 32 H100s and 2.4-3.7x at our 128k; the 97 percent energy is per-MAC arithmetic for silicon whose LLM SOTA is 370M parameters; and the measured energy levers at our scale are quantization and power capping, which the ladder already prescribes. What genuinely changes: the backbone rung's next candidate spec is now hybrid-linear (constant state, long context cheap) with five verified open 7B-14B models to test behind a $0 Vulkan gate probe, and convert-don't-train makes architecture conversion a priced option instead of a research project. The brain part decorates: spiking silicon is closed to NO for 2026, the estate had already converged on only-thinks-when-triggered at the system level before reading a word of the paper, and the one port the turn earns is a threshold-adaptation tweak in attention_ranker. Efficiency as sovereignty is the right law, but this estate exercises it through bytes and knobs and a $300 body, not through neurons; the turn's real gift is the proof that the architecture layer, not the accelerator layer, is where a compute bound loosens, and the export-control bound never bound here in the first place.
